title: PHINIA to Participate in Wells Fargo’s 16th Annual Industrials Conference
summary: PHINIA Inc. (NYSE: PHIN), a diversified, industrial supplier and global leader in the development of fuel systems, electrical systems and aftermarket solutions, announced today that it will participate in Wells Fargo’s 16 th Annual Industrials Conference on Wednesday, June 10, 2026. Conference participation will be in-person and include a QA session to discuss dynamics across the various markets PHINIA serves around the world and the Company’s business. PHINIA’s President and CEO, Brady Ericson, and Senior VP and ​CFO, Chris Gropp, will participate in the QA session led by Wells Fargo’s Colin Langan.
